title: Adding another product family
purpose: Show adding a third family without changing interfaces or client logic.
alt: 추상 인터페이스를 유지하며 ConcreteFactory3와 ProductA3·ProductB3를 추가하는 확장
requiredChecks: AbstractFactory still has only createProductA()/createProductB(); Client and AbstractProductA/B unchanged.
Existing ConcreteFactory1 ProductA1/B1 and ConcreteFactory2 ProductA2/B2 remain.
New ConcreteFactory3 implements AbstractFactory and creates ProductA3/ProductB3 implementing corresponding abstract product types.
Caption distinguishes new family from product category and selects factory in setup only.
prompt: Create a NEW original English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern study blog. White background, navy large sans-serif labels, flat blue and teal cards, spacious connectors, no copied slide layout or logos. Monospaced class/method identifiers. Distinguish uses, implements and creates via labels on directional connectors. Title "Adding another product family". TOP "Unchanged contract: AbstractFactory" lists createProductA(): AbstractProductA, createProductB(): AbstractProductB. Client card→factory uses with subtitle Client logic unchanged. BELOW three family columns. First two muted cards "Existing family 1" ConcreteFactory1 / ProductA1 / ProductB1, "Existing family 2" ConcreteFactory2 / ProductA2 / ProductB2; caption implements AbstractFactory each. Third teal "NEW family 3" ConcreteFactory3 with upward implements arrow toAbstractFactory; downward creates branch ProductA3 caption implements AbstractProductA and ProductB3 caption implements AbstractProductB. Footer "Add one factory and its A/B products; select it during setup". No createProductC, no changed interfaces, no client→concrete product links.
